fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-11-10 states that Rs. 15,000 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved, on 2025-11-07 around 22:55 hrs. The online submission was made by Buvaneswari Murugan (9000000259). A further person, Venkat Palanisamy, an intermediary, using the number 9000000134, is stated to be associated with the incident. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The account reference SYN-ACC-100016 was noted in connection with the payment. The complainant alleged that Hariharan Babu may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000154. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00201, as the mobile number 9000000154 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, associate, mobile number, shopping complex, receiving account, night, suspect
